subject: Initial and last-used states of data
notes: kb/Work PB1133 (wave 1012 J). cite.py --check 14.6.2.3.2 'initialized by setting them to not be in any open mode' OK action 3. The RECURSIVE container that declares a FILE SECTION and contains programs now compiles: pb1133_recursive_container_file_section leaves the connector OPEN at the end of the second activation (last-used, 14.6.2.3.3), CANCELs the container, and the third activation's OPEN OUTPUT answers 00 (a connector still open would answer 41), while a contained program writes the container's static record area and stores its status in the container's static FILE STATUS item.
